281452353.description:
Mollie Kathleen Gold Mine Figurine Diorama
Cripple Creek, Colorado Souvenir
Amethyst Geode, Pyrite & Pewter Figurines, 6 Inch
Detailed mineral diorama souvenir from the historic Mollie Kathleen Gold Mine located in Cripple Creek, Colorado. Constructed on a natural purple amethyst geode matrix, this display depicts an underground mining scene accented with glistening pyrite clusters and iridescent mineral specimens. Miniature cast pewter figures of miners alongside a loaded ore cart and pine tree bring the Gold Rush heritage to life.
Natural amethyst crystal geode formation with sparkling purple druzy cavity
Detailed cast pewter miner figurines, ore car with pyrite, and evergreen tree
Embellished with brassy pyrite and iridescent chalcopyrite/peacock ore accents
Front pewter label reads "Mollie Kathleen Gold Mine Cripple Creek, CO"
Mounted to a square clear acrylic base plate for display stability
Condition:
Pewter figures, mine cart, and nameplate are securely attached with sharp cast detail. Crystal druzy and mineral clusters are intact with natural variations. Underside acrylic display stand shows glue and paper residue from a prior label. Rock matrix is solid and structurally stable with no observed cracks or repairs.
